title: Queen Autonomous Chat and A2A Delegation
request: Make the assistant able to access context of other chats, autonomously open new chats, and assign tasks to agents.
problem: Chat operations and A2A actions were UI-only, living inside ChatViewModel slash-command handlers with no background-side API.
root_cause: Long-lived Queen background work had just been moved out of ChatViewModel, but autonomous control methods had not been exposed yet.
fix_summary: Added listChats, createChat, postToChat, listAgents, delegateTask, and broadcast to QueenBackgroundService. Routed the corresponding slash commands in ChatViewModel through the singleton. Fixed A2ARegistryClient.listAgents() to unwrap the BrowserOS registry's {agents:[...]} wrapper. Added a standalone integration test.
laws: L2 GENERATION via T27-canon source files
L4 TESTABILITY via build + integration test + e2e
